name: plan-orchestrator
description: Manage Todos across projects, Codex tasks, branches, and worktrees.

interface.shortDescription: Route Todos into project-bound Codex execution lanes.
interface.longDescription: Capture Todos from text or screenshots, organize them in six clear states, and launch queued work in the correct project, worktree, branch, and Codex task.
